violated_contract: A scheduled batch worker's deployed cadence, task deadline, and owned asynchronous work must match its code-level lifecycle. A per-minute scheduler for an hourly job created overlapping executions, a shorter live task deadline cut off tail users, fire-and-forget webhooks outlived the Cloud Run process, and unbounded conversation history could exceed the model context for one heavy user.
canonical_prevention: The notifications deployment now owns and verifies one exact hourly UTC Scheduler target, pins a one-task 3600-second no-retry Cloud Run execution, bounds daily-summary conversation history before model invocation, awaits all webhook work before batch completion, and emits explicit delivered, skipped, failed, webhook, and query accounting.
